National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today, Thu 22 Oct, it opens at 10:00 AM and closes at 6:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 get in free with an ID card.
